topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture on cancer evolution and outlines the key learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through Darwinian natural selection acting on successive genetic mutations and transient epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how normal tissue hierarchies and stemness properties determine the cell of origin and fuel tumor growth in leukemias and solid tumors.

topics.label: Role of the Microenvironment and Inflammation in Tumor Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stromal interactions are necessary to drive tumor outgrowth and maintenance.

topics.label: Technological Profiling and Comprehensive Synthesis of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the modern sequencing and spatial technologies used to investigate tumor heterogeneity and synthesize the multi-factorial evolutionary model of cancer development.

topics.label: Closing Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
